messages:
deploy-bot: Planned deploy window 2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 UTC. Targets: runtime v2.14.1-rc, api v1.9.0, router v3.2.0, console v1.4.0. Rollout order: router -> runtime -> api -> console. Canary 5% (us-east) 10m. Quiet window enforced. Runbook: https://go/release/runbooks/3789

sam: quick Q — can console go after api? console change touches UI feature flag rollout.

gina: we need to ensure api's schema toggle is off during deploy, I set the toggle to off in staging, will mirror in prod.

liam: runtime has small kv eviction change. Suggest extra drain: runtime pods cordon 8m before canary.

nate: +1 to canary 5% -> 20% -> 100% with health gates. Propose automated hold if p95/p99 latency increases >50ms.

olivia: QA: will run smoke + regression suite (end-to-end customer flow) at each stage, ETA for results ~8m after each stage.

qa-bot: Smoke tests: auth flow, prompt->reply latency, model warm start, embeddings. All tests in run/tests/smoke.yml

deploy-bot: executing preflight checklist: config pins applied, db-migrations none, healthchecks added. Starting router canary now.

nate: router canary pods up. Observability: no errors in logs yet.

sam: router canary 5% showing slight spike in tail latency +12ms, looks within noise.

liam: checking runtime logs, found a WARN about kv eviction during warmup. I'll hold runtime rollout until we confirm.

deploy-bot: HOLD placed on runtime. Not progressing to runtime stage.

gina: turning on extended debug for runtime canary: ```kubectl -n runtime logs -l app=runtime -c runtime-agent --since=15m```

liam: found warmup race, added 2s sleep in startup; patch applied to rc image 2.14.1-rc -> 2.14.1-rc2. Recommend re-run canary.

sam: re-run plan accepted. Re-scheduling runtime canary in 6m to allow router to settle.

deploy-bot: runtime canary started with rc2. Monitoring health gates.

nate: runtime canary 5%: memory and p95 fine, no kv errors.

olivia: QA smoke passed on runtime canary. Proceed when 10m steady.

deploy-bot: advancing router->runtime->api. Starting api canary now. API pinned with schema toggle off.

gina: api canary ok, small 500 spike at minute 3, traced to a downstream cache miss, auto-retry fixed. No rollback.

sam: console deploy scheduled last. No feature flags affected.

deploy-bot: stepping console canary. All health gates green.

qa-bot: Full regression pass done, no new regressions. Release notes draft: https://go/releases/notes/3789-draft

olivia: I'll add a note about the runtime startup fix and the schema toggle requirement.

nate: Post-deploy: recommend 24h metric watch and a quick follow-up in #eng-sre channel.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete. Window closed. If issues open INC-2026-45. Thanks team :thumbsup:
